reasons.claim: Eight consecutive monthly sales declarations are reported with a single consistent provenance (Declaración mensual sintética).
Sales show a declining trend from 2026-01 to 2026-04 (4,612,300 to 4,139,000 ARS) followed by a partial recovery through 2026-08 (4,507,200 ARS).
All amounts are labeled SIMULADO, so figures may not reflect actual reported sales.

questions: Why are all records labeled SIMULADO, and is there non-simulated evidence available?
What caused the sales decline from January to April 2026 and the subsequent recovery?
Can the declared amounts be corroborated against VAT/invoicing records or bank deposits?
Are sales figures nominal or inflation-adjusted, given the Argentine context?
missingData: No corroboration from independent sources (e.g., VAT filings, bank statements) beyond the synthetic monthly declarations
No prior-period or year-over-year comparison data
No explanation for the mid-period decline and recovery
All data is marked SIMULADO; authenticity of figures unverified
